name: [🎭PUPPET]⚡RUNNING FREDBEAR!!!⚡
desc:
⚠️ DON'T LOOK BACK... ⚠️

You wake up in an abandoned pizzeria, covered in dust, silence... and memories best forgotten.

The lights flicker, the air feels heavy... and something is still stirring inside you.

💨 Sprint Fredbear doesn't stop. He doesn't hesitate. He runs without limits.

If he sees you, he'll chase you, and you won't get a second chance.

🔦 Explore the pizzeria, stay out of his sight, and find a way to survive.

Every hallway hides a story... and every shadow could be your end.

♻️ Every server restart = a new update.

There's always something new lurking in the darkness.

🎮 Available for PC, mobile, and consoles!

👁️‍🗨️ Run. Hide. Survive.
